offer.text: Something bit me in the dark, my love, and I can feel it taking hold — I'm so cold. There's a way back, a golden apple and a steady hand. Please. Don't let me turn.

accept.text: Hurry, my heart. I'll hold on as long as I can.

decline.text: No — don't go. Please don't leave me to this.

in_progress.text: It's spreading... the cure, love, quickly.

ready.text: The cold... it's loosening its grip. You're saving me.

complete.text: I'm myself again. You pulled me back from the edge of something awful. I owe you my very soul.
